description: This file contains handlers for managing execution notes in a workflow system, including adding notes and retrieving notes for a specific execution, implemented as HTTP endpoints using the Gin framework.

methods.name: AddExecutionNoteHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for adding a note to an execution, validates input, updates the execution record, and publishes an event.

methods.name: GetExecutionNotesHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for retrieving notes associated with a specific execution, with optional tag filtering.
